name: Ratings Fixer
description: Writes stricter Custom Ratings from TMDb certifications, Common Sense Media ages (via MDBList) and your own rules, so Jellyfin's parental controls work on old and unrated titles. Preview first, raise-only by default, with a restorable ledger. Back up your Jellyfin database before the first Apply.
overview: Re-rate your library to modern parental-rating standards.
